TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
         id  TYPE i,
         qty TYPE i,
       END OF ty_order.
TYPES ty_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH DEFAULT KEY.

DATA gt_prod_ord_list TYPE ty_orders.
DATA gs_order TYPE ty_order.
DATA gv_text TYPE string.
DATA gv_count TYPE i.
DATA gv_subrc TYPE i.
DATA gr_table TYPE REF TO data.
DATA gr_line TYPE REF TO data.

FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_data> TYPE data,
               <lv_field> TYPE any.

FIELD-SYMBOLS <gt_itab> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
FIELD-SYMBOLS <gv_line> TYPE any.

FIELD-SYMBOLS <gt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

FIELD-SYMBOLS: <gt_dyn_table>     TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
               <gt_alv_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
               <gv_alv_line>      TYPE any.

FIELD-SYMBOLS: <gs_prod_ord_list> LIKE LINE OF gt_prod_ord_list.

FIELD-SYMBOLS <struc> TYPE any.

FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE any.
